text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Shuka Sho just around 
the corner—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—...I've thought a lot about it, and I 
really do want to run in the Shuka Sho 
too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Right after the Oaks ended, Chrono-chan 
declared to me that she would run in the 
Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan back then had this... this 
magnetic pull, or strength... that just 
made you unable to look away.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want to clash with her head-on on the 
track and find out for myself just what 
that is...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm sure doing so... will help me 
as I walk through my world from here on 
out."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Is that a no?
choice_data_list: No, that's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You and Chrono Genesis. Because 
they fiercely clashed in the Oaks, a 
strong mutual awareness exists between 
them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might lead to bolstering Loves Only 
You's strength. Besides, I also want to 
respect her wishes.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan...! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, meticulous preparations were made 
for the race to ensure thorough aftercare 
would be possible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Shuka Sho had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ......Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you manage to eat properly this 
morning?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ All the preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"How about you, Chrono-chan? You arrived 
early, but were you able to eat properly?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine. At least, not enough to 
affect my running."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...To be completely honest, I didn't think 
Love-chan would run. And that it couldn't 
be helped...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yet right now, you are... standing 
right here— Why... is that?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――I want to run with Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"We're in the same grade, roommates, and 
from the same debut class. We've run the 
Classic races together, too. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I want to run together in 
the Shuka Sho too, the final race of the 
Tiara route...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just completely natural?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Loves-chan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Today... I came here in peak condition, 
armed with the evolved Genesis Method.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I will show you. All of it. 
............Let the contest begin.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(What an overwhelming presence...! 
Chrono-chan has come this far...!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose, Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't come here just to run alongside 
Chrono-chan. I came here to win...!"
